mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions, which positively impacts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in >40% of instances when UNRATE is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month indicates strengthening demand in the housing market, which spills over into broader economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Housing starts increase by >5% yet S&P 500 returns are negative in >50% of the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below its 12-month moving average and GDP growth (GDPC1) is positive, it indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below its 12-month moving average with positive GDP growth results in negative S&P 500 returns in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% signals monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 4% yet S&P 500 returns remain positive in >50% of the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals improved supply chain activity and productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Industrial production increases by >1% yet S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% yet S&P 500 returns are negative in >50% of the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 0.5% month-over-month and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (year-over-year inflation < 3%), it indicates healthy demand without inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Retail sales growth >0.5% with stable inflation results in negative S&P 500 returns in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in housing starts (HOUST) growth during a late-cycle expansion signals reduced demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Housing starts growth slowdown during late-cycle expansion results in positive S&P 500 returns in >50% of the next 60 trading days.
